name: codex-design
description: Create interfaces or slides beside your conversation, with a shared project design system, board inspiration, anchored discussions and design-to-code handoff.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit interface designs, diagrams, application states, slide layouts and shared React components beside your conversation. Select an inner component to edit its source in isolation, manage project boards, discuss designs in anchored comments, and export source for implementation. Runs locally on desktop with Node.js 22 or later. An independent community project; not made or endorsed by OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Design an interface or slide deck on the canvas.
Review design comments and update the current board.
